[[File:Nam_Beroya.png|thumb|left|200px|Nam Beroya, whom the Rebel agents tried to rescue from slavers.]]
While searching for allies to aid them in repelling an [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|upcoming Imperial attack]] on [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]], a notorious slaver hideout operated by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]].

During this time, Molec lost his [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] champion, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]]&mdash;known as the "Prince's Sword"&mdash;to trade [[Baron/Legends|baron]] [[Dorn Sevelle]] of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] after losing a gambling bet. Molec promised to provide the Rebels with soldiers if they retrieved the Prince's Sword. To this end, the agents raided slaving camps on Kowak in an attempt to '''rescue''' Nam Beroya.
